outcome: mental health issues (depression, postnatal depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, panic attacks)
cohort: The study included 100 consecutive pregnant smokers and 110 contemporaneous non-smokers who delivered at a large urban maternity hospital in Oct-Nov 2017.
finding: Maternal cigarette smoking was associated with poor obstetric outcomes, including lower birth weight and higher rates of small for gestational age infants, and there was an identified absence of smoking cessation services and intervention in their care pathways.
birth_weight: Mean 3.16 kg for infants of smoking mothers vs 3.47 kg for non-smokers.
